item.description:
Beta release — thanks for testing.

New

  • Add a room to music from an Apple TV, iPhone or Mac. When a room plays music sent from another device, ticking another room now brings it in: the new room picks up the same song at the same spot and the album continues, and the rooms already playing join it.

Fixes

  • Volume works again on added rooms. Volume is back to how it worked in 1.0.23, and both halves of a stereo pair now change together.
  • Any room can leave a group, including the one the music started in. The other rooms keep playing.
  • HomePods paired with an Apple TV show their real volume instead of a faded placeholder, and every speaker remembers its last volume between launches.
  • A steadier speaker list. Each room is one line that keeps its height, every ticked room has its own volume bar, and a room's volume is off while it's joining or leaving.
  • Adding a room is more reliable and no longer reports a failure before it succeeds.

Beta release — thanks for testing.

New

  • Up Next. The new list button next to the mini player button shows what your HomePod plays next. Drag songs to reorder them, remove one with ✕, double-click one to play it now, or clear the rest. Works when the HomePod plays Apple Music itself, for example songs started from this app or with Siri.
  • Play Next and Play Last. Right-click any song, album or playlist, or use the … button on a song, to add it to what's playing without stopping the current song.
  • Search finds artists and playlists. With Apple Music access allowed, search shows Top Results, artists and Apple Music playlists such as "R.E.M. Essentials". Click an artist to see their top songs and albums.
  • Keyboard shortcut. Set one in Settings › General to open and close HomePod Controller from any app, like clicking the menu bar icon.

Fixes

  • Group volume moves together. The − and + keys now change every room in a group by the same amount at the same moment, including HomePods paired with an Apple TV.
  • New searches start at the top instead of where the previous results were scrolled to.

Beta release — thanks for testing.

Fixes

  • Speakers stay in the list. On some Wi-Fi networks a speaker could drop out of the list for a moment, or a stereo pair could briefly show as one of its halves. The app now asks speakers directly and remembers where they are, so every room shows up when the app opens and stays put.
